title: One-step compression of DNF gates under random restriction
statement:
Let $g_1,\dots,g_{s_2}$ be DNF formulas on $n \ge 1$ variables, each of width at most $w$, where $w \ge 1$; assume that in every term of every $g_i$ any two literals on the same variable coincide (so no term repeats a variable or contains both a literal and its negation) and no literal occurs twice in the term. Fix a natural number $\ell$ and a real $p$ with $0 < p \le \tfrac{1}{40w}$ and $p \le 1$. Then, for a Bernoulli-$p$ random restriction $\rho$ of the $n$ variables,
\[
  \Pr_\rho\Bigl[\text{for every } i,\ g_i|_\rho \text{ is computed by some CNF formula of width } \le \ell\Bigr]
  \;\ge\; 1 - s_2\left(\left(\tfrac12\right)^{\ell} + \exp\!\left(-\tfrac{np}{3}\right)\right),
\]
where $g_i|_\rho$ is the restriction of $g_i$ by $\rho$ and a CNF formula $\psi$ *computes* $g_i|_\rho$ when $\psi$ and $g_i|_\rho$ agree on every input.

each gate has width at most w
